name: battlepanic-web-build
description: Web build for Battle Panic with Google Firebase Authentication and per-user Firestore cloud saves.

scripts.build-web: rm -rf web-build && mkdir -p web-build && cp -R index.html battlepanic.swf firebase ruffle web-build/
scripts.check: npm run build-web && node --check firebase/auth.js && node --check firebase/firebase-client.js && node --check firebase/firebase-config.example.js && node --check firebase/firebase.js && node --check firebase/save.js
